paragraphs: Hyman cites Bamidbar Rabbah 2:24 for the wording “asked before Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama in the name of Rabbi Simon.” He says that Vayikra Rabbah 20:10 attributes the statement to R’ Yochan of Jaffa.

notes.text: The notice does not make clear whether the attribution to Rabbi Simon belongs to the question or its answer. The bounded Bamidbar Rabbah 20:14 check did not locate this passage.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. II, p. 686) gives פ״ב־כד, whereas the supplied transcription has פ״כ־יד. In the consulted Bamidbar Rabbah 2:24, Rabbi Yochanan of Jaffa asks Rabbi Pinchas bar Chama. The parallel in Vayikra Rabbah 20:10 names Rabbi Yudan of Jaffa and Rabbi Pinchas bar Rabbi Chama. Both include Rabbi Simon’s name and discuss the death of Aaron’s sons.
